My dear [Anne](/person/930)
[Mrs Keble](/person/797) has just returned me this, it had no end to it and I hope it ought not.

How very interesting it is and how heart stirring [Miss Arthur](/person/65)’s letter, which I am sending to Mrs T Keble.[^1] Our [Nets](/periodical/94) are not come yet. I forgot to tell you of Miss Parkes’ Vignettes to order. I think you would find much to interest you
Your most affectionate

C M Yonge


[^1]: The enclosure was no doubt some comment on the recent death of [John Keble](/person/798) and his wife, about which CMY had been corresponding with his sister-in-law Elizabeth Jane Keble (Mrs Thomas Keble).

Anne Mackenzie edited a missionary magazine called The Net, and Mary Arthur, a missionary in South Africa, was probably one of her correspondents.
